channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: State audit flags compliance failures at the Agriculture and Industries Department
item.description: Audit found Alabama Agriculture Department failed to properly verify lawful presence and had no uniform bad check fees, repeating previously cited compliance problems.

item.title: Opinion | When cruelty toward the dead reveals a deeper moral failure
item.description: Trump’s words after a critic’s death violated centuries-old moral restraints and revealed a deeper erosion of character and leadership.

item.title: AJ McCarron drops lieutenant governor bid for football job
item.description: Former Alabama quarterback AJ McCarron suddenly ended his lieutenant governor bid Wednesday, citing a new football career opportunity.

item.title: Alabama receives $11.7M grant for mine reclamation, job creation
item.description: Two Hoover projects received more than $11.75 million in federal grants to revitalize former coal mine sites, driving economic growth and creating hundreds of jobs.

item.title: Sen. Matt Woods prefiles Trey’s Law bill
item.description: Woods prefiled Trey’s Law Wednesday, aiming to end the misuse of nondisclosure agreements against child sexual abuse victims in civil settlements.

item.title: Rep. Sewell blasts GOP for failing to extend ACA tax credits
item.description: House Republicans declined to extend expiring ACA enhanced premium tax credits, potentially doubling costs and causing 130,000 Alabamians to lose coverage.

item.title: Gov. Ivey orders Space Force flags to be flown across the state in weeklong “show of support”
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey marked the Space Force's sixth birthday, honoring the branch and reflecting her commitment to keeping Alabama central to space development.

item.title: Alabama Board of Pharmacy weighs civil penalties schedule
item.description: The Board of Pharmacy debated a new civil penalty schedule, aiming to balance minor in-state violations with stronger enforcement against serious out-of-state misconduct.

item.title: Opinion | In primetime address, Trump tried to blame everyone else for his failing economy
item.description: Like a bad pitchman, Trump tried to sell you a worthless story and a lot of lies. No one is falling for it.

item.title: Alabama joins FTC deceptive practices lawsuit against Uber
item.description: The coalition alleged Uber charged customers without consent, failed to deliver promised benefits, and made canceling subscriptions exceedingly difficult.
